findings.issue: Manual theme toggle broken - CSS only matches @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark), no .dark class selector
findings.impact: F1 integrity violation. ThemeProvider applies .dark class but CSS never matches it. All manual light/dark selections have no effect.
findings.fix: Add .dark selector alongside the media query or restructure to class-based theming

findings.issue: --color-accent-reference, accent-primary CSS variable referenced but never defined in any @theme block
findings.impact: Undefined CSS variable falls through to browser default. Callback page may render with incorrect colors.
findings.fix: Define --color-accent-primary in styles.css or replace with --color-brand-primary

findings.issue: No member list or member management page exists
findings.impact: F2 gap. Users cannot navigate to view or manage workspace members. Missing primary navigation target.
findings.fix: Add /members route with member list, role display, and invite UI

findings.issue: Thread replies cannot be edited, deleted, or reacted to
findings.impact: F3 gap. Thread replies are read-only after sending. Users cannot correct mistakes or express reactions in threads.
findings.fix: Add edit/delete actions and reaction support to thread panel

findings.issue: Duplicate --font-sans and --font-mono declarations in globals.css and styles.css
findings.impact: Minor F1 violation. Unnecessary duplication may lead to drift.
findings.fix: Remove duplicate font declarations from globals.css

findings.issue: No route-group-specific 404 page - invalid channels show inline 'Channel not found' text
findings.impact: F2 gap. No proper 404 UX with navigation options for invalid workspace/channel routes.

findings.issue: No per-user presence indicators - only aggregate 'N online' count displayed
findings.impact: F3 gap. Users cannot see who is online. Reduced chat awareness.
findings.fix: Add green dot indicators next to user names in message list

findings.issue: No reaction tooltip showing who reacted to a message
findings.impact: F8 gap. Users see reaction counts but cannot know who reacted. Reduces social interaction quality.
findings.fix: Add hover tooltip on reaction pills with user names/avatars

findings.issue: Mixed icon library usage - dialog uses Unicode '✕', sidebar-group uses Unicode '▸', toast uses inline SVGs, rest of app uses lucide-react
findings.impact: F9 violation. Three different icon approaches create visual inconsistency and different sizing behaviors.
findings.fix: Migrate all icons to lucide-react components

findings.issue: Thread replies area has no aria-live region for screen reader announcements
findings.impact: F5 gap. Screen reader users are not notified when new replies appear in the thread panel.
findings.fix: Add aria-live='polite' region to the thread reply list

findings.issue: Ctrl+1-9 workspace switching listed in help dialog but not implemented
findings.impact: F8 gap. Help dialog shows non-functional shortcuts, eroding user trust.
findings.fix: Implement workspace switching shortcuts or remove from help dialog

findings.issue: Keyboard shortcuts not discoverable - no UI hint or '?' icon anywhere
findings.impact: F8 minor. Power users may never discover the shortcut system exists.
findings.fix: Add a '?' button to app header or sidebar

findings.issue: Root error.tsx has empty useEffect(() => {}, [error]) - error not logged or reported
findings.impact: F4 minor. Root error boundary swallows errors silently with no logging or Sentry reporting.
findings.fix: Add console.error and Sentry.captureException to the useEffect

findings.issue: Avatar uses tag instead of Next.js Image component
findings.impact: F7 minor. Avatar images are not optimized, lazy-loaded, or responsively sized by Next.js.
findings.fix: Switch to Next.js Image component with priority for header avatars
